subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 41 13 storefront glazing system at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 41 13 storefront glazing system at the entry vestibule are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? This is becoming a priority as fabrication approaches. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This is holding up fabrication in this area. A response within three days would be appreciated.
